specs.title: Check 1: No horizontal scroll
Check 2: Hero chips do not intersect face-safe zones (widened by 3%)
Check 2b: Hero headline and subcopy do not collide with hero photo
Check 2c: Hero chips have complete text without truncation or ellipsis
Check 3: MediaFrames cover mode has no empty band and cutout mode is flush at bottom
Check 4: "PATH" is fully visible or absent
Check 5: CTA photo is at least 96% of panel height and flush at bottom
Check 6: Pinned scroll and mouse parallax are inactive when pointer is coarse
Check 7: Testimonial review categories exist and contain at least 25 reviews each
